definitions.explanation: An organization or facility dedicated to scientific or academic research.

examples.japanese: {国立|こくりつ}{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work at a national research institute.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新薬|しんやく}→新薬：28055_shinyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This research institute is developing new medicines.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The university's research institute made an announcement about the latest technology.

notes:
{研究所|けんきゅうじょ} is a compound of ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧ (research) + {所|じょ} (place, facility). It refers to an institution dedicated to research.

PRONUNCIATION:
An alternate reading けんきゅうしょ also exists and is used in some proper names. The じょ reading is more common in general usage.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {国立|こくりつ}{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}: national research institute
- ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{附属|ふぞく}→附属：00050_fuzoku⟧{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}: university-affiliated research institute
- {研究所|けんきゅうじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work at a research institute
- {研究所|けんきゅうじょ}⟦{長|ちょう}→〜長：04665_chou⟧: director of a research institute

WELL-KNOWN EXAMPLES:
- {理化学研究所|りかがくけんきゅうじょ} (RIKEN): Japan's largest scientific research institution
- {産業技術総合研究所|さんぎょうぎじゅつそうごうけんきゅうじょ} (AIST)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {研究所|けんきゅうじょ}: research institute (independent facility)
- ⟦{研究室|けんきゅうしつ}→研究室：01397_kenkyuushitsu⟧: research lab/office (within a university)

cross_references.description: Alternate reading けんきゅうしょ
